key_facts: Modular monolith with NestJS modules: VideoModule + SubtitleModule
2 DB tables for Feature #1: videos + subtitle_segments
Zod schemas in packages/shared for frontend+backend validation
yt-dlp via child_process.execFile for subtitle extraction
100ms polling for YouTube IFrame subtitle sync
Composition root at AppModule — all DI wired there
Error handling: AppError with categories + global exception filter
call_chains: AppModule -> VideoModule -> VideoService -> VideoRepository (Drizzle) -> videos table
AppModule -> SubtitleModule -> SubtitleService -> SubtitleRepository (Drizzle) -> subtitle_segments table
Frontend: UrlInputForm -> API client -> POST /api/v1/videos -> VideoService
Frontend: useSubtitleSync -> player.getCurrentTime() -> match cue -> highlight line
